name: Peanut-Free Millet Pongal
ingredients: ¼ cup split yellow moong dal, rinsed
steps: Dry-toast moong dal in a saucepan for 2 minutes until aromatic; do not brown deeply.
Add rinsed millet, water, turmeric and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 18–20 minutes, stirring once or twice, until millet and dal are soft. Add hot water if needed.
Warm oil in a small pan. Add cumin, pepper, ginger and curry leaves; sizzle briefly.
Pour tempering over pongal and stir. Serve soft and hot with sambar.
note: A nut-free, dairy-free pongal. Millet cooking times vary; follow the package if it differs.
